messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — onboarding partner 'CloudFab' sent an aggregated usage payload (session-level) and we're seeing doubled token counts in EU.

maria: ugh. do we have an example payload? can we map session -> requests? :thinking_face:

sam: redacted sample they sent:

```
{
  "partner_id": "cloudfab-23",
  "session_id": "s-abc123",
  "start": "2026-03-20T12:00:00Z",
  "end": "2026-03-20T12:40:00Z",
  "tokens_used": 12000,
  "sku": "cf-pro"
}
```

sam: they send total tokens per session; our billing and entitlements are per-inference-call. a 40m session shows as 12k tokens in one row.

june: does CloudFab have request-level detail we can ask for? session-level is cheaper but loses SKU granularity and region allocation.

alex: short-term we can apply a heuristic: split session tokens across avg tokens-per-call per-SKU. reduces immediate double-billing but it's approximate.

maria: i worry about reconciliation and auditability. heuristics are ok temporarily but need deterministic records.

billing-bot: ingest-error partner=cloudfab-23 event=missing_region field=region severity=warn

ops_lead: most of these sessions miss region; they appear to be eu-central. misattributing region affects credits and tax lines.

sam: proposal:
- hotfix: ingestion creates synthetic call rows from session payload by splitting tokens into N calls using sku_default_avg_tokens map. tag synthetic=true for audits.
- medium: update partner schema to require request_list or call_count + region_breakdown + optional per-call timestamps.
- long: partner profile compatibility flag so ingestion knows whether aggregated sessions are allowed.

june: +1. add ingestion metric: fraction_of_tokens_marked_synthetic and reconciliation delta per-partner.

alex: timeline: hotfix deployed by EOD tomorrow to avoid weekend billing spikes. contract/schema change tracked in partner-contracts repo; AE to sign off this week.

maria: action items:
- @sam: implement hotfix mapping + synthetic tagging (PR + tests) — due 2026-03-25
- @june: add synthetic_token metric to billing dashboard and alert if >5% for any partner — due 2026-03-26
- @alex: schedule partner call to require region + call_count fields and share reconciliation concerns — scheduled 2026-03-24 @10am PT
- @ops_lead: update reconciliation playbook with steps to reverse synthetic mappings if partner provides retroactive call-level data — due 2026-03-27

maria: quick SQL for ops audit:

```
SELECT partner_id, session_id,
  SUM(case when synthetic='t' then tokens else 0 end) as synthetic_tokens,
  SUM(tokens) as total_tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE partner_id='cloudfab-23' AND created_at >= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY partner_id, session_id;
```

sam: i'll open the PR and include an e2e test that asserts totals reconcile when partner later provides per-call rows.

alex: thanks. tagged AE @maria to push contract change. if anyone sees anomalous EU tax lines this week ping me. :pray:

billing-bot: deploy-hook: ingestion-service hotfix build=2026.03.24-rc5 started

june: can we add a console note "Partner usage shape heuristic applied" with link to docs? transparency helps customers.

alex: yes, add partner docs entry and a 48h console banner showing synthetic count.

maria: keeping thread open for updates. will post PR link when ready.
